method: Playwright Incapsula solve (iPhone UA per DB userAgentOverride, 13 cookies incl. visid_incap_3254206/incap_ses_1848_3254206/nlbi_3254206/PHPSESSID) -> 15 spaced (>=2.6s) axios GETs with the cookie bundle across Store API /products, WP REST core /wp/v2/product (the watermark surface), /wp/v2/product_cat, Store API /products/categories, and 2 HTML category pages. STOP-on-escalation armed (403/429/503/307/302/interstitial/network). Mirrors production waf-cookie-manager.ts:79-173 + woocommerce.ts:306-369.

reachabilityVerdict.evidence: All 15 spaced requests returned HTTP 200, zero escalation: no 403/429/503, no 307/302 redirect, no Incapsula interstitial on ANY surface, no network reset. The Incapsula cookie session carried EVERY gated surface. X-Iinfo on all WP REST calls = '...SNNN' (S=cookie-session-validated, NNN=not-challenged); Store API = 'NNNN'. Critically, /wp/v2/product (the watermark surface R1-blind found CHALLENGED on cookieless axios) returned clean JSON on probes 2,3,4,5,6,10,13,14 with the cookie. Sustained over 8 WP-REST calls + 4 Store-API calls + 2 HTML pages + 2 category-API calls without a single re-challenge. Held budget 1800 (~4s gap at capacity 0.517) is more conservative than the 2.6s test gap, so production pace is safer than the test that passed.
